_note: Pricing assumptions for the three acquisition modes. None is a quotation; each is a scenario parameter to be replaced by evidence.

fleetCostOfCapital.rationale: asset-company funding cost band; chapter 9 hypothesis

agencyFeeMonthly.rationale: Agency service fee per active contract

marginShare.rationale: lifecycle operator margin on fixed subtotal

warrantyPoolShare.rationale: annual provision for unplanned repair, share of asset cost

firstLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: chapter 2.7: a new vehicle consumes more mobility value per month than later lives

laterLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: later lives consume the asset more slowly

ownershipRepairProvisionShare.rationale: annual expected unplanned repair for a private owner without risk pooling, share of purchase price

reassignmentCost.rationale: one-off logistics, handover and records when a customer moves vehicle

maintenanceAgeFactorPerYear.rationale: scheduled maintenance cost grows 4% per year of vehicle age

maintenanceKmExponent.rationale: maintenance scales sub-linearly with distance: fixed service intervals plus wear
